lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized into approximately five vertical columns in the region posterior to the gills and anterior to the first dorsal fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with specular highlights on the upper surface and shadowing beneath.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A clear notch is present on the posterior margin of the first dorsal fin; additional minor irregularities are visible on the distal margin of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a significantly higher density of smaller-diameter high-luminance points compared to the more sparse, larger blobs on the lateral flank.
